records.summary: Process-level chronic gut-derived initiation regime in which dysbiosis and microbial-component translocation repeatedly elevate basal immune activation and stabilize inflammatory baseline shift.

records.description: Tissue Repair and Regeneration denote the admissible process-level arising through which damaged or lost tissue structures are restored by coordinated multicellular reconstruction within an existing organismal context. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as temporally organized repair and regenerative rebuilding that mobilize proliferation, migration, differentiation, debris clearance, matrix remodeling, and spatial re-patterning under guidance from pre-existing tissue architecture. The arising is realized when tissue-scale morphogenetic templates, cellular stress-response capacity, genomic maintenance, and local inflammatory-regime control are jointly integrated into a reconstruction trajectory that restores functional structure while preserving broader multicellular coherence. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because the principal ontological unit is an organized restorative transformation unfolding over time rather than a static tissue object or a persistent spatial pattern alone. This arising establishes the regenerative and reparative dynamics required for wound closure, structural restoration, controlled rebuilding after injury, and partial recovery of tissue-specific organization and function.
records.name: Tissue Repair and Regeneration
records.shortDescription: Process-level arising of controlled tissue restoration through coordinated repair, proliferation, differentiation, and remodeling under tissue-scale spatial guidance.
records.summary: Process-level arising of controlled tissue restoration through coordinated repair, proliferation, differentiation, and remodeling under tissue-scale spatial guidance.

records.description: Systemic Allocation Trade-off between Immune Surveillance and Repair denotes the admissible property-level arising through which organism-level immune regulation settles into a constrained balance between surveillance-oriented functions and repair-oriented functions under chronic inflammatory, infectious, degenerative, or aging-related load. This arising is not a simple alternation between two tasks. It is a persistent allocation property of the organism expressed in how immune resources, signaling priorities, activation thresholds, effector deployment, and regulatory attention are distributed between elimination of infected, transformed, damaged, or senescent targets and support of tissue repair, resolution, regeneration, and structural maintenance. As chronic inflammatory background rises, these objectives increasingly compete for limited immune-operational capacity, so that gains in one dimension can narrow the admissible range of performance in the other. The arising thus captures a stable organism-level trade-off envelope governing how immune coordination apportions protective aggression versus reparative compatibility across tissues and time.
records.name: Systemic Allocation Trade-off between Immune Surveillance and Repair
records.shortDescription: Property-level organism-scale allocation constraint balancing surveillance-oriented immune functions against repair- and resolution-oriented priorities under chronic load.
records.summary: Property-level organism-scale allocation constraint balancing surveillance-oriented immune functions against repair- and resolution-oriented priorities under chronic load.

records.description: Inflammaging Regime Stability and Hysteresis denote the admissible property-level arising through which chronic low-grade inflammation becomes stabilized as a self-maintaining organism-level regime that resists reversal even after partial weakening of its initiating drivers. This arising is not identical to chronic low-grade inflammation itself, but to a higher-order stability property of that regime once repeated inflammatory activation, impaired resolution, immune-metabolic feedback loops, tissue inflammatory microenvironments, senescence-associated signaling, and altered repair balance have become sufficiently integrated to create path dependence. In such a configuration, the threshold for entering the inflammatory regime becomes lower than the threshold for fully exiting it, producing hysteresis: the organism remains trapped in an elevated inflammatory state despite only modest current stimulation. The arising therefore captures the fact that chronic inflammatory persistence is not always maintained by strong ongoing triggers alone, but can become structurally stabilized by feedback-dominated regime memory. Within SOMA this is a property because it characterizes the long-term stability structure of an organismal inflammatory regime rather than constituting a separate bounded process or tissue object.
records.name: Inflammaging Regime Stability and Hysteresis
records.shortDescription: Property-level self-maintaining chronic inflammatory regime that resists reversal through hysteresis and feedback-dominated persistence.
records.summary: Property-level self-maintaining chronic inflammatory regime that resists reversal through hysteresis and feedback-dominated persistence.

records.description: Age-Associated Immune Remodeling (Immunosenescence) denotes the admissible property-level arising through which the composition, responsiveness and regulatory balance of the organism's immune system change progressively with age under the combined influence of adaptive-compartment remodeling, trained innate reprogramming and persistent low-grade inflammatory background. This arising is not identical to chronic inflammation itself and not reducible to one isolated defect in either innate or adaptive immunity. It is expressed through loss of naive lymphocyte reserves, shifted frequencies of memory and innate cell subsets, biased innate reactivity and narrowed adaptive flexibility, which individuals traverse along heterogeneous longitudinal trajectories that can be summarized as an immune age associated with clinical outcome. Within SOMA this is classified as a property because it characterizes the organism by its age-dependent immune state rather than by one bounded process episode or one discrete immune object.
records.name: Age-Associated Immune Remodeling (Immunosenescence)
records.shortDescription: Property-level organism-scale remodeling of immune composition, responsiveness and regulatory balance with age and chronic inflammatory load, followed along longitudinal immune-age trajectories.
records.summary: Property-level organism-scale remodeling of immune composition, responsiveness and regulatory balance with age and chronic inflammatory load, followed along longitudinal immune-age trajectories.

records.description: Vasomotor Regulation of Tissue Perfusion denotes the admissible process-level arising through which a formed vascular network matches local blood flow to tissue demand by changing vessel diameter. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as dynamic control of arteriolar, precapillary and capillary tone by contractile mural cells, whose state is set by local metabolic, endothelial and neural signals, so that activity in a tissue is followed within seconds by a matched change in local perfusion. The arising is realized through smooth-muscle contractility and relaxation, vasoactive signaling such as nitric oxide and prostaglandin pathways, and coupling to neural activity; arteriolar smooth-muscle segments produce prompt dilation and constriction, while the contribution of capillary pericytes depends on preparation and remains unresolved. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because the principal ontological unit is the ongoing regulation of flow rather than the vascular network that carries it. This arising establishes the demand-coupled perfusion control required for organ homeostasis and for the coupling of blood supply to neural activity.
records.name: Vasomotor Regulation of Tissue Perfusion
records.shortDescription: Process-level arising of demand-coupled control of local blood flow through mural-cell-mediated changes of vessel diameter.
records.summary: Process-level arising of demand-coupled control of local blood flow through mural-cell-mediated changes of vessel diameter.

records.description: Organization of the Extracellular Matrix denote the admissible object-level arising of a persistent extracellular scaffold when secreted matrix components, cell-matrix interactions, and tissue-scale mechanical constraints become integrated into a stable organized extracellular architecture. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured matrix object composed of aligned fibrillar, adhesive, and hydrated extracellular components that provide mechanical support, define tissue boundaries, transmit forces, and modulate diffusion and signaling conditions across tissues. The arising is realized through coordinated matrix deposition, alignment, crosslinking, remodeling, and cell-mediated anchoring, yielding an extracellular structural unit that persists beyond momentary cellular actions and functions as an active organizational medium for multicellular architecture. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is a bounded and persistent extracellular structural formation with identifiable tissue-level presence and organizational function. This arising establishes the extracellular scaffold required for tissue integrity, force distribution, positional stabilization, matrix-mediated signaling modulation, and long-range structural coordination across multicellular systems.
records.name: Organization of the Extracellular Matrix
records.shortDescription: Object-level arising of a persistent extracellular scaffold that organizes tissue mechanics, boundary structure, and matrix-mediated signaling conditions.
records.summary: Object-level arising of a persistent extracellular scaffold that organizes tissue mechanics, boundary structure, and matrix-mediated signaling conditions.

records.description: Physiological Regulation and Organ Homeostasis denote the admissible property-level arising of stable organ-scale functional regulation when tissues and organs are integrated into distributed feedback architectures that maintain viable internal conditions across the multicellular organism. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as the sustained capacity to regulate organ variables such as pressure, temperature, chemical composition, flow conditions, and functional output within bounded operational ranges despite ongoing perturbation. The arising is realized through coordinated cross-tissue signaling, feedback control, structural coupling, local maintenance mechanisms, and systemic regulatory compensation, yielding a persistent regulatory property of organ systems rather than a single transient process episode or a single bounded anatomical object. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the stable regulatory capacity of organs and organ systems to preserve functional state under variable conditions. This arising establishes the multicellular homeostatic capacity required for physiological stability, organ function preservation, systemic balance, and adaptive compensation across distributed tissue networks.
records.name: Physiological Regulation and Organ Homeostasis
records.shortDescription: Property-level arising of stable organ-scale functional regulation through distributed multicellular feedback, signaling coordination, and systemic constraint maintenance.
records.summary: Property-level arising of stable organ-scale functional regulation through distributed multicellular feedback, signaling coordination, and systemic constraint maintenance.

records.description: Development of the Vascular System denotes the admissible object-level arising of dedicated multicellular transport networks that distribute oxygen, nutrients, metabolites, and signaling substances across tissues and organs. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured vascular architecture composed of branching conduits, differentiated vessel segments, and exchange interfaces that connect tissue morphology to metabolic demand and support scalable multicellular viability. The arising is realized through angiogenic guidance, in which endothelial tip cells follow growth-factor gradients and extend sprouts that lumenize behind the tip, through branching control and lumen formation, and through flow-dependent remodeling, in which hemodynamic force reorganizes the primary plexus into a hierarchical tree. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable vascular network with stable anatomical presence and transport function. This arising establishes the transport infrastructure required for tissue perfusion, metabolic support, spatial scaling of organs, removal of byproducts, and distribution of signaling substances throughout multicellular systems.
records.name: Development of the Vascular System
records.shortDescription: Object-level arising of branched, lumenized vascular transport networks formed through guided angiogenic sprouting and flow-dependent remodeling.

records.description: Nervous System and Physiological Coordination of Organs denote the admissible object-level arising of distributed neural control architecture that coordinates organs and tissues through rapid signal propagation and organized excitable pathways. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured multicellular network object composed of specialized neuronal and glial elements arranged into reflex pathways, autonomic branches, conduction routes, and organ-coupling circuits that support fast physiological timing and control. The arising is realized through neural differentiation, membrane excitability, synaptic signaling, pathfinding, and circuit stabilization, yielding a persistent coordination system that links distant tissues into temporally organized regulatory action. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable neural system architecture with stable anatomical presence and coordination function, rather than a single signaling event or a higher-level cognitive property. This arising establishes the rapid-control infrastructure required for reflex arcs, autonomic regulation, temporal synchronization of organ activity, and fast physiological coordination that complements slower hormonal and metabolic regulation.
records.name: Nervous System and Physiological Coordination of Organs
records.shortDescription: Object-level arising of distributed neural coordination networks enabling rapid timing, reflexive control, and physiological synchronization across organs and tissues.
records.summary: Object-level arising of distributed neural coordination networks enabling rapid timing, reflexive control, and physiological synchronization across organs and tissues.

records.description: Endocrine Regulation and Hormonal Systems denote the admissible object-level arising of distributed hormonal control architecture when specialized endocrine cells, secretory tissues, circulating carriers, and hormone-responsive targets become integrated into a body-wide regulatory system. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured multicellular signaling network object composed of endocrine glands, hormone-producing cells, circulating messengers, target receptors, and feedback-linked regulatory pathways that coordinate growth, metabolism, reproduction, stress response, and long-term physiological state. The arising is realized through hormone synthesis, secretion, circulation-dependent distribution, receptor-specific recognition, and feedback stabilization, yielding a persistent systemic regulatory formation that complements faster neural coordination with slower but sustained modulation of organismal regimes. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable endocrine system architecture with stable anatomical and functional organization across physiological contexts. This arising establishes the long-range hormonal infrastructure required for concentration-dependent regulation, coordinated state modulation across distant organs, and persistent adjustment of organism-level physiological regimes.
records.name: Endocrine Regulation and Hormonal Systems
records.shortDescription: Object-level arising of systemic hormonal regulation architectures enabling slow, sustained coordination of physiological states across distant organs and tissues.
records.summary: Object-level arising of systemic hormonal regulation architectures enabling slow, sustained coordination of physiological states across distant organs and tissues.

records.description: Organism-Scale Immune Defense Architecture denotes the admissible object-level arising through which diverse immune, barrier, inflammatory, surveillance, and regulatory subsystems become integrated into a coherent organism-scale protective architecture capable of preserving integrity across heterogeneous tissues and environmental exposures. This arising does not consist merely in the coexistence of multiple immune mechanisms, but in their stable structural integration into a distributed defense object whose components coordinate recognition of threats, mobilization of effectors, control of inflammatory amplitude, elimination of pathogens or damaged cellular targets, maintenance of tissue-compatible protection, and restoration of functional continuity after perturbation. It includes the organized coupling of barrier interfaces, innate immune recognition, cytokine communication, myeloid and lymphoid specialization, surveillance of transformed or infected targets, systemic alerting, and regulatory circuits that prevent uncontrolled self-damage. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the immune system at this scale functions as a persistent organized whole with identifiable internal architecture, distributed yet bounded operational unity, and stable causal participation in organism-level survival, repair, and adaptive protection.
records.name: Organism-Scale Immune Defense Architecture
records.shortDescription: Object-level integrated immune-defense architecture coordinating barrier protection, surveillance, threat response, clearance, and systemic protective regulation.
records.summary: Object-level integrated immune-defense architecture coordinating barrier protection, surveillance, threat response, clearance, and systemic protective regulation.

records.description: Formation of Neural Networks denotes the admissible pattern-level establishment of persistent connectivity architectures among differentiated excitable cells, yielding reproducible topologies, directed pathways, weighted couplings, and modular organization. Within Level 6 this arising is not a transient growth episode and not a single bounded object, but a stable relational pattern in which neurons become organized into enduring connection graphs that constrain future propagation dynamics. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because its identity is defined primarily by repeatable structural organization across many cellular carriers rather than by one individuated material body. The resulting network architecture provides the structural substrate for coordinated signal transmission, long-range integration, local clustering, hub formation, rhythmic coupling, plastic reweighting, and later functional specialization without yet implying learning, cognition, or behavior as distinct higher-order arisings.
records.name: Formation of Neural Networks
records.shortDescription: Stable pattern-level formation of reproducible neural connectivity architectures enabling distributed signal propagation, coordination, and later specialization.
records.summary: Stable pattern-level formation of reproducible neural connectivity architectures enabling distributed signal propagation, coordination, and later specialization.

records.description: Synaptic Plasticity and Learning denotes the admissible process-level reconfiguration of synaptic strengths, efficacies, and local connectivity patterns within established neural networks as a function of activity history. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended modification dynamics including potentiation, depression, synaptic stabilization, and weakening, through which prior activation leaves persistent causal traces in later network behavior. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity depends on ordered change over time rather than on a static object, pattern, or property taken in isolation. Learning at this level is therefore treated as regulated trajectory-level updating of neural connection architecture through activity-sensitive synaptic mechanisms, without yet requiring symbolic representation, explicit world models, cognition, or conscious awareness. This arising establishes the dynamic basis for adaptive retention, experience-sensitive reweighting, and selective reshaping of neural propagation pathways within already formed network organization.
records.name: Synaptic Plasticity and Learning
records.shortDescription: Process-level activity-dependent reconfiguration of synaptic connectivity that stores prior activation into future neural response dynamics.
records.summary: Process-level activity-dependent reconfiguration of synaptic connectivity that stores prior activation into future neural response dynamics.

records.description: Regulation of Sleep–Wake Cycles denotes the admissible property-level organization by which neural systems maintain and transition between distinct global operating modes corresponding to wakefulness and sleep. Within Level 6 this arising is expressed as a system-wide regulatory condition involving coordinated changes in excitability, synchrony structure, neuromodulatory tone, oscillatory organization, and large-scale patterns of information flow. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because its identity lies in a global regime-defining condition attributable to the organized neural system rather than in one isolated event, static pattern, or bounded object. This arising governs access to wakeful responsiveness, sleep-stage organization, plastic consolidation windows, metabolic recovery allocation, and homeostatic restoration timing across the neural system. It functions as a network-wide control property that gates the admissibility of consciousness-related availability, modulates learning efficiency, and stabilizes organism-level coordination, without itself constituting conscious content or specific cognitive processing.
records.name: Regulation of Sleep–Wake Cycles
records.shortDescription: Property-level global state regulation of neural operating modes governing transitions between wakefulness and sleep.
records.summary: Property-level global state regulation of neural operating modes governing transitions between wakefulness and sleep.

records.description: Functional Specialization of Neural Ensembles denotes the admissible pattern-level organization in which subsets of neurons within large-scale neural networks acquire stable and preferential roles in processing, integration, coordination, or control. Within Level 6 this arising is not a single bounded object and not merely a transient activation episode, but a reproducible mesoscopic pattern defined by differentiated recurrent participation, intra-ensemble coherence, inter-ensemble coordination, and role-specific deployment across broader network architecture. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because its identity is determined by stable relational organization among groups of neural carriers rather than by one isolated process or one intrinsic property of individual neurons. These ensembles function as intermediate organizational units bridging single-neuron activity and whole-network dynamics, enabling modular differentiation, repeated functional allocation, and structured division of labor while preserving global coherence. This arising establishes the patterned mesoscopic organization through which neural systems become functionally differentiated without yet requiring symbolic representation or conscious awareness.

records.shortDescription: Pattern-level stabilization of distinct functional roles in mesoscopic neural subsets within large-scale network organization.
records.summary: Pattern-level stabilization of distinct functional roles in mesoscopic neural subsets within large-scale network organization.

records.description: Information Processing in Neural Connectomes denotes the admissible process-level organization by which the structural topology and dynamical regimes of large-scale neural connectivity architectures jointly enable distributed transformation, routing, propagation, and integration of activity. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended operations of parallel transmission, convergence, divergence, recurrent circulation, hub-mediated redistribution, and multi-path integration across the connectome. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ordered causal transformation and routing dynamics unfolding through time rather than by one static network pattern, bounded object, or abstract property. Information processing at this level refers to physically realized causal organization of population activity across connectomic structure, grounded in material connectivity and regime-dependent dynamics rather than abstract computation or symbolic manipulation. This arising establishes the process architecture through which large-scale neural systems propagate and transform activity across distributed pathways while preserving structured coordination across specialized and recurrently coupled subsystems.
records.name: Information Processing in Neural Connectomes
records.shortDescription: Process-level distributed transformation, routing, and integration of activity across large-scale neural connectivity architectures.
records.summary: Process-level distributed transformation, routing, and integration of activity across large-scale neural connectivity architectures.

records.description: Astrocytic Regulation of Neural Activity denotes the admissible property-level organization by which astrocytes maintain and modulate the operating conditions of neural circuits. It is realized through Kir4.1-dependent potassium buffering and transporter-mediated glutamate clearance, vesicular glutamate release by specialized astrocytes, lactate export through monocarboxylate transporters needed for long-term memory formation, and noradrenaline-driven astrocytic calcium integration that suppresses futile behavior. These conditions shape short- and long-term plasticity and behavioral state without encoding the content processed by neurons; astrocytic calcium elevation is not required for every form of hippocampal plasticity. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because its identity lies in a persistent regulatory condition of neural–astrocytic organization rather than in one event or object.
records.name: Astrocytic Regulation of Neural Activity
records.shortDescription: Property-level astrocytic control of the synaptic and network environment, through potassium and glutamate clearance, gliotransmission, lactate supply and neuromodulator-gated suppression of behavior, that tunes plasticity and behavioral state.
records.summary: Property-level astrocytic control of the synaptic and network environment, through potassium and glutamate clearance, gliotransmission, lactate supply and neuromodulator-gated suppression of behavior, that tunes plasticity and behavioral state.

records.description: Neural-State-Dependent Epigenetic and Transcriptional Modulation denotes the admissible process-level arising through which sustained patterns of neural activity, neuromodulatory state, and neuroendocrine regulation induce durable changes in chromatin accessibility, transcriptional regulation, and epigenetic marking within target cells and tissues. This arising is not a simple one-step signaling event. It consists in an extended cross-level regulatory transformation linking neural-state organization to downstream molecular reconfiguration through activity-dependent transcriptional cascades, hormone-sensitive pathways, intracellular signaling networks, and long-duration gene-regulatory adjustment. As this process unfolds, target cells can shift responsiveness, stress adaptation, differentiation bias, metabolic readiness, or long-term functional profile in ways aligned with organism-level neural context. The arising therefore captures a genuine downward causal process in SOMA terms, in which higher-order neural-state regimes reshape lower-level molecular permissibility without erasing the molecular substrate on which that reshaping is realized.
records.name: Neural-State-Dependent Epigenetic and Transcriptional Modulation
records.shortDescription: Process-level cross-level regulation in which sustained neural states drive durable epigenetic and transcriptional reconfiguration in target cells.
records.summary: Process-level cross-level regulation in which sustained neural states drive durable epigenetic and transcriptional reconfiguration in target cells.

records.description: Neuro–Immune Interactions denotes the admissible process-level reciprocal coupling by which neural network dynamics and immune signaling mutually modulate inflammation, immune readiness, neural excitability, plasticity, and network stability. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended cross-system exchange mediated through autonomic pathways, neuroendocrine signaling, neuromodulators, cytokines, inflammatory mediators, and tissue-level immune feedback. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ongoing bidirectional modulation and causal exchange across organizational systems rather than by one static property, bounded object, or stable pattern alone. This arising formalizes a diagonal causal loop linking neural dynamics with organismal defense and maintenance mechanisms, allowing neural activity to reshape immune responses while immune state feeds back to alter gain, stability, affective bias, and plastic adaptability of neural organization. It establishes a cross-level regulatory process through which organism-wide physiological defense and neural coordination become reciprocally coupled.
records.name: Neuro–Immune Interactions
records.shortDescription: Process-level bidirectional cross-system coupling through which neural states and immune activity reciprocally modulate one another.
records.summary: Process-level bidirectional cross-system coupling through which neural states and immune activity reciprocally modulate one another.
